name: feature-grid
description: 特性网格：2×2 打勾特性卡，逐格点亮
css: #tpl-feature-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .fg-hair { width: 64px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .85; margin-bottom: 3vh; transform-origin: left center; } .fg-title { font-size: 4.4vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .fg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2.4vh 4vw; } .fg-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.6vh; font-size: 2.5vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .fg-check { width: 3.4vh; height: 3.4vh; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); color: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 800; flex: none; }
body:
{{title}}
✓{{f1}}
✓{{f2}}
✓{{f3}}
✓{{f4}}
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .fg-hair", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .fg-title", { y: 34, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }, {start} + 0.2);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .fg-item", { opacity: 0, x: -34 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.16 }, {start} + 0.5);
